params.name: email_config
params.description: Pass the ID of the email feed source to retrieve emails from a specific source. By default, emails from all email sources are retrieved. To retrieve the email source ID, use the **GET Email Source List API** under **Administration** > **Integration management** > **Email Feed Sources**.

params.name: is_read
params.description: Pass true to retrieve read emails only. By default, both read and unread emails are retrieved.

params.name: is_starred
params.description: Pass true to retrieve starred emails only. By default, both starred and non-starred emails are retrieved.

params.name: is_regulatory_email
params.description: Pass true to retrieve regulatory emails only. By default, both regulatory and non-regulatory emails are retrieved.

params.name: is_delete
params.description: Pass true to retrieve trashed emails only. By default, trashed emails are not returned.

params.name: q
params.description: Pass the query text to search in the subject and body of emails.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Pass the number of emails to retrieve on each page.

params.name: page
params.description: Pass the page number to retrieve emails.

params.name: has_attachments
params.description: Pass true to retrieve emails with attachments.

params.name: is_reviewed
params.description: Pass true to retrieve reviewed emails only. By default, both reviewed and unreviewed emails are retrieved.

items.docs: Returns a list of email messages received from email feed sources.
